t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Red, brown and purple gnomes are for the red basket while the yellow, blue, light brown and green are for yellow basket. Match the basket and the gnomes to get the best score and once the count starts running low, switch to the other gnomes and basket gnome set.

vb_textbox.text: The most important thing is to switch when the score starts reducing, the red, brown and purple gnomes are linked to the red basket while the yellow, light brown , green and blue are linked to the yellow basket, keep switching as the score is reducing for optimal advantage.
